evidence.summary: TV09 shows six placed pieces including a finish and a ghost straight; TV12 shows real decoration tools. Passed TV03 verifies world/ghost/save/cold-library reload.
TV05 shows the edited red car with white flame livery and its inspector; actual paint and sticker controls support it. Passed TV02 verifies native edits, save and cold Garage reopen.

TV20 shows real cars and a track world during the native countdown; TV21 shows a moving driver-view race. Passed TV05 verifies draft test-drive return and TV09 verifies camera/radio controls. No track/editor UI substitutes for a race scene.
TV16 shows the native racer wardrobe, a changed hat, color and glasses controls. Passed TV06 verifies a personal racer saved and cold reopened.
TV04 shows the selected red paint on the real car and metallic/body controls. Passed TV02 changes body/wheel paints before saving.

TV07 shows native pen controls, brush width, ink choices and a short white stroke beside the yellow pen cursor. Passed TV02 exercises pen-down/directional drawing and saved drawing inspection; this is remote input, not touch.
TV06 shows one selected star sticker, 52% horizontal positioning and size controls on the edited car. Passed TV02 places/moves the sticker and checks its saved state.
TV12 shows a placed decoration and rotate/move controls; TV09 supplies actual track context. Passed TV04 verifies directional decoration and portal placement.

TV14 shows saved personal tracks alongside starter tracks, with the edited car as supporting imagery. Passed TV03 verifies save/cold-library load and TV02 verifies saved car reopening. The transitional Garage capture is excluded.

TV21 shows the genuine driver race with a visible BOOST meter; TV20 shows the real cars/world. Passed TV08 verifies Select starts remote boost, meter consumption and Play/Pause stops it. TV19 is excluded because its frame is blocked by an orange wall.
